Privacy

Updated 2 November 2026

This site is run by the owner of the domain name Totterdown.com. This page explains what data the site collects and why.

Analytics and cookies

The site doesn't set cookies or use analytics that track you. Cloudflare, which hosts the site, keeps short-lived server logs to deliver pages and protect the site from attacks.

Contact and offer form

The "Make an offer" button and the contact links open a Google Form. The details you enter are stored in Google Forms and used only to reply to your enquiry. They aren't sold or shared with anyone else, and other people who fill in the form can't see your answers.

Hosting

The site is served by Cloudflare. Like any website host, Cloudflare processes your IP address to deliver pages and block attacks. See Cloudflare's privacy policy.

Other websites

This site links to other websites, which have their own privacy policies. We aren't responsible for how those websites collect or use your data.

Your rights

Under UK data protection law you can ask to see, correct or delete data held about you. To do this, use the contact form and say your message is about privacy. You can also complain to the Information Commissioner's Office.
